query:
SELECT db.id, db.carId, db.dealerId, db.bidAmount, db.message, db.status, db.createdAt, c.make, c.model 
FROM dealerBids db 
LEFT JOIN cars c ON db.carId = c.id 
WHERE db.message LIKE '%Buy Now%' 
ORDER BY db.createdAt DESC 
LIMIT 5;
